paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者白天有事务交流，晚间却想找人分享一个小进展而没有合适机会；另一天则愿意安静独处。想要的陪伴、实际联系与是否愿意独处分别保留，不用身边人数解释感受。例子不要求联系谁、重做安排或把没有适用记忆换成没有注意到。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader has practical exchanges during the day but no suitable evening opportunity to share a small success. On another day, quiet solitude is welcome. Wanted company, available contact and welcome solitude remain separate, without surrounding headcounts explaining the feeling. The scene requires no contact, repeated arrangement or unavailable memory changed to did not notice.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只读虚构情境，当时想要的是哪种陪伴？还有什么实际条件没讲到？”可以保留未知。听者不从计数评判合群程度，不把独处当成失败，也不替任何人承诺陪伴；无需分享个人记录，选择不尝试同样可以结束。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks what company was wanted in the fictional scene and which practical conditions remain unmentioned. Unknowns may stay unknown. A listener rates no sociability from counts, treats solitude as no failure and promises no company on someone’s behalf. No personal record or attempt is needed to finish.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，围绕过去四周自己的观察，不评定他人或关系。21条仍按三个主题各七条归入六类：没有注意到、很少、有时、较常、经常、未计分。类别标识不是点数；每主题六类计数合计七条，保留逐条标签，不加总为分数、不算均值、不找最高主题或划孤独等级。计数是陈述数量，不是互动次数、天数或强度。没有经历、回想不清或保留回答的未计分，与没有注意到分开；任一类别少或全部未计分都不证明没有困难。相同计数可以来自不同陈述，不比较进步、恶化或活动效果。原题本不是UCLA量表，尚无已建立的信效度、常模或中英文测量等值；WHO概念区分不验证本题组，不推导个人健康后果。无需披露、联系、加入、同化、每日监测或完成任务才可询问支持。三篇公开全文与支持说明始终可读；原有页面内存记录、退出重做刷新离页清除、不存草稿或提交的行为保持不变，复制只含公开标题与入口，不含个人观察或计数。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading about your own observations over the past four weeks, not assessments of others or relationships. Twenty-one statements retain three themes of seven and six categories: did not notice, rarely, sometimes, often, very often and unscored. Category identifiers are not points. Six counts in each theme account for seven statements, with individual labels retained and no point total, mean, highest theme or loneliness level. Counts describe statements, not interactions, days or intensity. No experience, unclear recall and withheld answers remain unscored, separate from did not notice. Few responses in a category or an entirely unscored record establish no absence of difficulty. Equal counts can involve different statements and establish neither progress, deterioration nor an activity’s effect. The original form is not the UCLA scale and lacks established reliability, validity, norms or English–Chinese measurement equivalence. WHO conceptual distinctions validate neither this inventory nor personal health consequences. No disclosure, contact, joining, assimilation, daily monitoring or completed task is needed before asking about support. All three public full guides and support information remain available. Existing page-memory records, exit or retake clearing, reload or leaving clearing, no drafts and no submission remain unchanged. Copying includes only the public title and entry link, without personal observations or counts.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构人物希望先把一个普通困扰说完，收到的却是有用的事务建议；建议的帮助与尚未被听见的部分可以同时承认。另一人也许正想要建议，不能用同类计数替其选择。例子不判断谁听得对，也不要求加大披露、重开谈话或用回应验证在意程度。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, someone wants to finish describing an ordinary concern but receives useful practical advice. The help and the still-unheard part can both be acknowledged. Another person might want advice immediately; similar counts cannot choose for them. The scene judges no listening as correct and requires no extra disclosure, reopened conversation or response used to test care.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只看虚构请求，倾听、建议、实际帮助和陪伴分别指什么？哪些内容可以不讲？”无需提供自己的困扰。听者不以计数规定谁必须提供支持，也不把保密当作拒绝帮助；可以暂缓、保留边界或只读到这里。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card distinguishes listening, advice, practical help and company in a fictional request, with details that may remain private. No personal concern is needed. A listener uses no count to assign a support duty and treats privacy as no refusal of help. Postponing, keeping boundaries or ending the reading remains an option.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构人物希望参加固定活动，却因照顾责任错过时间；另一人能到场，但不了解谈话默认的背景。参与机会与理解背景是不同条件，不凭计数推断社交能力、身份问题或他人排斥意图。例子不要求加入、反复请求进入或披露身份来测试接纳。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, one person wants to attend a regular activity but misses its time because of caring responsibilities. Another can attend but lacks assumed conversational background. Access and background understanding differ. Counts infer neither social ability, an identity problem nor an intention to exclude. The scene requires no joining, repeated access request or identity disclosure to test acceptance.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只为虚构活动区分时间、参与方式和需要说明的背景，哪些信息仍要由具体场所确认？”可以不提出真实请求。听者不把一次尴尬判为永久排斥，不要求改变自己来融入，也不把障碍全交给个人解决；不参与也是可保留的选择。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a fictional activity’s time, access and background explanation, leaving actual availability for the setting to confirm. No real request is needed. A listener calls no awkward moment permanent exclusion, requires no changed self to fit in and assigns no individual the whole task of removing barriers. Not participating remains an option.
